_note: How often this model's published intervals actually contained the result. Derived from the experimental-settlement ledger, which grades every published forecast against the official final score. Educational and paper-only; not a betting record.

total.claim: an interval printed as 80% contained the result 87.8% of the time over 41 settled forecasts — consistent with the label
